Name: Cream Modern Interior
Author: Suzilana
Description:
[ Content Patcher ] mod that changes the interior elements (beams, log panels, stairs and wall divider) in the Cream Modern style ✨

Farmhouse, Cabin and Island available, but you can choose to install only one in the config file.

Designed to match my other Cream Modern mods :
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11431]Cream Modern Kitchen[/url] 🍰
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11462]Cream Modern Fireplace [/url]🔥
➜ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13223]Cream Modern Corner Bathroom[/url] 💄

💜🌈

Downloads.Description: Adds compatibility with my new mod "Mini Greenhouse in the Farmhouse"
